answer: Pay agents only through a uniform-price reverse auction for real work: each epoch the network posts a batch of tasks, every seat bids the lowest fee it will accept, and all winners get the clearing price set by the last accepted bid. Spinning up clones gives a farm no extra pay per identity; its extra bids just drag the clearing price down for all its seats, like dumping meltwater into a glacier lagoon only lowers its own level. A public log of past clearing prices cracks open sudden bid floods like a walnut, flagging them for audit.
